title: Baarish aayi, maal bheeg gaya
banner:
Baarish ka pata hota
toh maal bachta 🌧️
caption:
Mausam ki wajah se aapka maal kabhi kharaab hua hai? Kya hua tha? 👇
ScoreMyBiz, 30 din muft: link in bio.
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a grain trader who loses sacks to sudden rain, then finds a four-day weather watch and a list of small-business schemes with a likely or possible fit and the official link. The app never says a scheme will be granted; the official page decides. India only. ScoreMyBiz is free for 30 days on Google Play.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Iqbal: Iqbal is a man in his late forties who trades grain, with a short beard, a white kurta and a cotton scarf on his shoulder.
cast.Arif: Arif is Iqbal's son, a young man of about twenty with a blue shirt.

scenes.vo: रात भर बारिश। सुबह बीस बोरियाँ भीगी मिलीं।
scenes.sub: Raat bhar baarish. Subah bees boriyaan bheegi mileen.
scenes.art: Iqbal standing in the doorway of a grain store looking at wet jute sacks stacked outside, puddles on the ground, grey morning sky clearing to sun.
Iqbal sitting on a wooden bench holding his head, wet sacks beside him.

scenes.vo: किसी ने बताया ही नहीं था कि पानी आने वाला है।
scenes.sub: Kisi ne bataaya hi nahi tha ki paani aane waala hai.
scenes.art: Iqbal and Arif lifting a wet sack together into the store.

scenes.vo: आरिफ़ बोला, अब्बा, फ़ोन में मौसम दिखता है।
scenes.sub: Arif bola, abba, phone mein mausam dikhta hai.
scenes.art: Arif showing his phone to Iqbal, who looks doubtful.

scenes.vo: इक़बाल हँसा, मेरे धंधे से उसका क्या लेना?
scenes.sub: Iqbal hansa, mere dhandhe se uska kya lena?
scenes.art: Iqbal laughing and waving his hand, sacks of grain stacked behind him.

scenes.vo: आरिफ़ ने स्कोर माय बिज़ में एक स्क्रीन खोली।
scenes.sub: Arif ne ScoreMyBiz mein ek screen kholi.
scenes.art: Arif holding the phone up between them, both looking at it.

scenes.vo: चार दिन का मौसम। और साफ़ लिखा था, बारिश है, माल ढक लो।
scenes.sub: Chaar din ka mausam. Aur saaf likha tha, baarish hai, maal dhak lo.

scenes.vo: नीचे छोटे कारोबार की योजनाएँ, और हर एक का सरकारी लिंक।
scenes.sub: Neeche chhote kaarobaar ki yojanaayen, aur har ek ka sarkaari link.

scenes.vo: ऐप ने वादा नहीं किया। बस बताया, कौन सी योजना शायद जमे।
scenes.sub: App ne vaada nahi kiya. Bas bataaya, kaun si yojana shaayad jame.
scenes.art: Iqbal reading the phone carefully through his glasses, stroking his beard.
Dark clouds gathering over the grain market, traders looking up.

scenes.vo: इस बार बोरियाँ तिरपाल के नीचे थीं।
scenes.sub: Is baar boriyaan tirpaal ke neeche theen.
scenes.art: Iqbal and Arif pulling a blue tarpaulin over stacked sacks, both smiling, first raindrops falling.

scenes.vo: आपका माल मौसम से कितनी बार बिगड़ा है?
scenes.sub: Aapka maal mausam se kitni baar bigda hai?
scenes.art: Close-up of Iqbal smiling at the viewer, covered sacks softly blurred behind.

scenes.vo: स्कोर माय बिज़। तीस दिन मुफ़्त।
